**Windows:** download `MathematicsVisualiser.exe` below and double-click it. No Python or installer needed.

**macOS / Linux:** `pipx install git+https://github.com/georgepol1023/Mathematics-Visualiser.git`, then run `mathviz`.

What's new: see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/georgepol1023/Mathematics-Visualiser/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
